description: Version of this observation contract.
UUID identifying this analysis run; measurements from different runs remain separate.
Stable experiment UUID.
Stable imported dataset UUID.
Stable field-of-view/time-series UUID; tracking never crosses sequences automatically.
Stable UUID for a logical multichannel image at one time point and analysis plane/volume.
Immutable UUID for a biological cell within the experiment. A division creates two new cell UIDs; the parent track ends.
Unique UUID for this cell observation in this run and image.
Image-source profile.
Identifier and version of the saved imaging/import profile.
Path to the source file relative to the dataset root; may represent a multichannel container.
Zero-based series index inside the source container.
Zero-based time index within the sequence.
Whether the segmented object is measured in a 2D plane or 3D volume.
Zero-based source Z plane for 2D plane analysis; null for volumes or projections.
Acquisition date and time in RFC3339 with explicit UTC offset. Null when unavailable; never substitute file modification time.
Provenance of acquisition timestamp.
Seconds since the first time point; may be known even if absolute acquisition time is unknown.
Time this observation was generated, RFC3339 with UTC offset.
Physical sampling interval along x in micrometres; null if uncalibrated or inapplicable.
Physical sampling interval along y in micrometres; null if uncalibrated or inapplicable.
Physical sampling interval along z in micrometres; null if uncalibrated or inapplicable.
Saved labeled-mask path relative to the run output root.
Positive integer uniquely identifying the object within this mask; zero is background.
CellProfiler object number in its image/object set. Join through the verified mask mapping, never assume equal numbering.
CellProfiler object set containing the segmented cell.

Human-readable code with origin prefix S=confirmed seeded, F=first-frame observed, D=daughter, E=entered field, U=unknown; e.g. S-L000001-G00-B000001. Descendants retain L and increment G, with sequence-wide unique B. Display metadata may change after lineage correction.
Cell UID of the earliest observed ancestor, not necessarily the originally seeded cell.
Immediate parent cell UID; null when absent or unknown.
Number of observed divisions from the earliest observed ancestor, not absolute biological generation.
Evidence-based origin; first_frame_observed does not imply seeded.
Evidence/review status of the current lineage assignment.
Calibrated probability for the proposed parent link, only if supplied by a validated method; otherwise null.
Version of the lineage assignment; revisions preserve cell UIDs where identity is unchanged.
Aggregate quality status. Unassessed is distinct from pass.
Machine-readable flags; empty means no recorded flags, not proof of passing QC.
Human review status.
Completion of CellProfiler measurements for this object.
All registered numeric CellProfiler measurements. Keys match the run feature dictionary. Null means unavailable; zero remains a measured zero.
Predicted probability of death within death_prediction_horizon_h; null until a validated prediction is available.
Prediction horizon in hours from this observation.
Predicted cell-cycle phase at death; null when unavailable. No phase is inferred merely from death probability.
allowed_values: G0 | G1 | S | G2 | M | unknown

description: Versioned prediction model identifier; required for any populated prediction.
User-defined, namespaced annotations, such as user.treatment or model.future_score. Reserved fields cannot be overridden.
Instrument name recorded by the acquisition system. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.
Manufacturer of the imaging instrument. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.
Hardware model of the imaging instrument. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.
Instrument serial number; preserve as text including leading zeros. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.
Hardware revision of the imaging instrument. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.
Firmware version of the imaging instrument. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.
Name/product of the software that acquired the image; separate from analysis software. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.
Version of the acquisition software. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.
Build identifier of the acquisition software. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.
Manufacturer of the acquisition camera. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.
Hardware model of the acquisition camera. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.
Camera serial number; preserve as text. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.
Objective identifier/model recorded in metadata. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.
Per-field extraction provenance for imaging hardware/software fields. Include every such field, even when unknown. Metadata conflicts are retained and flagged for review.
